description:
Export the full visitor log history from Jolly Lobby Track to a file on the Desktop. 

Goal: Save a comprehensive export of visitor records to 'C:\Users\ga\Desktop\visitor_audit_export.csv' (or .txt/.xls). 

The export must include: 
- All visitor records currently in the system (ensure no filters hide data)
- Standard columns (Name, Company, Host, Date, Time)

Start by ensuring you are in the Report or Log view, select all records, and use the Export or Save As feature.
